record.question: Who discovered penicillin?
record.explanation: Answer A: Alexander Fleming. Alexander Fleming observed penicillin’s antibacterial effect in 1928. Development into a usable therapy involved Ernst Chain and Howard Florey as well. Reference: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1945/summary/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
